name: Identifies the saved run and names the generated topology.
description: Describes the scenario for the operator.
organisation_type: Labels the sector; does not create sector-specific segments.
scenario_label: Adds a scenario description to the specification.
analyst_notes: Local working notes excluded from the assessment report. Do not enter secrets.
seed: Controls deterministic generation. Keep fixed during comparisons; a new seed may change the environment.
hosts: Total inventory, bounded at 40. Subnet capacities and group counts must each sum to this value.
segmentation: Changes permitted inter-zone model relationships when firewall segmentation is enabled.
dmz: In the wizard, turning this on labels the first subnet DMZ. Turning it off changes its role to internal.
identity_roles: Selected role names label generated identity nodes. An empty selection omits identity generation.
target_group: Zero-based device-group index. Each host in this group receives an objective, in addition to flagged groups.
objective: Objective description. The three wizard choices all use the asset-access terminal rule.
critical_asset_label: Optional display name shared by generated target assets. Empty uses generated names.
max_steps: Episode horizon. Small budgets can end progression early; larger budgets allow more decisions and evidence.
episodes: Number of recorded episodes, each with a deterministic episode seed.
policy_id: Fixed Engineering V2 Reasoner / masked heuristic. Arbitrary wizard scenarios have no verified PPO binding.
action_masking: Fixed true. Restricts decision selection to valid simulator actions.
partial_observability: Fixed true. Decisions use observed knowledge; full scenario inventory is analyst context.
reward_profile: Fixed engineering-exclusive-v1 reward semantics. No alternative profile is selectable.
subnets[].label: Name displayed for this logical zone.
subnets[].size: Number of hosts allocated to the zone. Device groups in the zone must fill it exactly.
subnets[].role: Purpose of the zone. An isolated-critical destination restricts modelled cross-zone transitions when segmentation is active.
devices[].category: Labels the generated hosts; use a category offered by the API.
devices[].count: Number of hosts generated in this group. Must fit the assigned zone.
devices[].os_version: Synthetic version label included in host and assignment metadata.
devices[].role: Business or technical purpose displayed in inventory and reports.
devices[].criticality: Descriptive asset criticality; objective selection uses the target group and crown flag.
devices[].subnet: Zero-based zone index used to record membership.
devices[].internet_exposed: Public-exposure inventory flag. Does not create an Internet route.
devices[].crown_jewel: Adds an objective on each host in this group. The primary target group is always included.
services[].name: Service template label used on hosted service nodes.
services[].version: Synthetic service version retained as inventory metadata.
services[].port: Service port metadata. No listener or network connection is created.
services[].device_group: Null applies to all device groups. A group index limits where services and associated conditions exist.
services[].accessibility: Descriptive scope of a synthetic service. Does not grant reachability.
services[].authentication_required: Authentication inventory label. Does not enforce the separate MFA model.
services[].importance: Descriptive service importance for inventory interpretation.
vulnerabilities.mode: Automatic synthetic rules or catalogue annotations. Catalogue mode requires available selected records.
vulnerabilities.cvss_min: Lower synthetic score bound or catalogue filter; cannot exceed the upper bound.
vulnerabilities.cvss_max: Upper synthetic score bound or catalogue filter; cannot be below the lower bound.
vulnerabilities.per_host: Assignment attempts per host. Patching, hardening and service scope may reduce the resulting count.
vulnerabilities.access: Chooses local host or remote service transition requirements within the simulator.
vulnerabilities.privilege: Requested model access after a successful transition. Restricted administration can cap it.
vulnerabilities.service_index: Zero-based affected service template. Must reference an existing template.
vulnerabilities.catalogue_ids: Selected catalogue records must exist and fall within score bounds. Annotations do not establish real applicability.
controls.firewall_segmentation: Constrains generated cross-zone relationships according to the segmentation profile.
controls.mfa: Omits abstract identity-to-host/container access links when enabled.
controls.patch_coverage: Fractional chance to suppress a synthetic assignment. This is modelled coverage, not measured compliance.
controls.monitoring: Descriptive monitoring flag. No active defender or prevention effect is implemented.
example_origin.preset_id: Read-only identifier of the loaded versioned example.
example_origin.specification_sha256: Original template specification digest; editing the copy does not change this value.
example_origin.topology_sha256: Original example topology digest. Review computes the edited scenario digest.
